- [article.adapters.dev_to](_autosummary/article.adapters.dev_to.html.md): Dev.to adapter — Phase 2 syndication via the Forem API V1 (&#96;httpx&#96;).
- [article.adapters.hashnode](_autosummary/article.adapters.hashnode.html.md): Hashnode adapter — Phase 2 syndication via the Hashnode GraphQL API (&#96;httpx&#96;).
- [article.adapters.medium](_autosummary/article.adapters.medium.html.md): Medium adapter — Phase 2, as an honest manual step (“Import a story”).
- [article.adapters.substack](_autosummary/article.adapters.substack.html.md): Substack adapter — Phase 1 primary: an &#42;&#42;unpublished draft&#42;&#42;, via python-substack.
- [article.base](_autosummary/article.base.html.md): Core vocabulary for the &#96;article&#96; publishing pipeline.
- [article.config](_autosummary/article.config.html.md): Domain schema + configuration facade.
- [article.engine](_autosummary/article.engine.html.md): Orchestration engine — the two-phase, canonical-URL SSOT pipeline.
- [article.md_source](_autosummary/article.md_source.html.md): Read an article from a plain Markdown file (no JSON envelope needed).
- [article.registry](_autosummary/article.registry.html.md): Adapter &#96;Protocol&#96; + an open-closed registry keyed by platform name.
- [article.state](_autosummary/article.state.html.md): Pipeline state store — a &#96;MutableMapping&#96; facade over a JSON backend.
- [article.util](_autosummary/article.util.html.md): Thin, dependency-light utilities shared across the package.
